Any more useful detail at ''all''?''"<br />"''No, Lord Jabba.''"<br />"''Have they tried ''very'' hard, do you think?''"<br />"''Yes, Lord.''"<br />"''Execute them, then.|Jabba Desilijic Tiure and the Nikto captain|<ref name="TCW-novel" />}}
This '''[[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]]''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] Nikto guards during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After Jabba's son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], was kidnapped from his [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]], Jabba ordered the captain to execute the crew of the sail barge in order to show that failure on their scale would not be tolerated.<ref name="TCW-novel" />
